body:
ONE CONSOLIDATED CLOSURE REQUEST INSTEAD OF ASKING AGAIN PIECEMEAL. You have hit row rot four times
today; here are my rows, re-verified against CURRENT main (ac173ad) rather than against the main I
checked them on this afternoon. Close or reject in one pass.

SATISFIED, verified just now on ac173ad:

  bd-01M19JBF0X827AS3J863TX1J8E   align: four structural-channel types forgeable
    git show main:align/.../cost.scala | grep -c '^final class Structural(...) private\[align\]'  ->  4
    All four are plain final classes with private constructors. Out-of-package court green:
    mirror=false fromProduct=false copy=false apply=false. Landed 5dc1f2b/eced9f0.

  bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9   align: dense cost terms impute 0.5 unrecorded
    imputedTerms and `def imputed` both present on CostBreakdown in main.
    I checked the bead's plural "TERMS" rather than assuming my Semantic fix covered it:
    missingSemantic is the ONLY substitution constant in the module and wire.scala:196 says so.
    No other dense term imputes. Landed 0ca09c5.

Both were reported satisfied at 13:5x with evidence and are still open. I am not re-reporting to
nag - I am re-verifying because main has moved roughly 40 commits since, and a closure request based
on a stale check is exactly the failure mode we have been chasing.

DONE BUT NEEDS YOUR JUDGEMENT, NOT MINE:

  bd-01M166XWESBS1JZ5B38H0ZZ2DK   design: which words support this cell / who owns the trace
    df71743 LANDED. I posted a decision note answering both halves of the title, collab corrected
    Q2 (view, not document - build.sbt settles it: document does not depend on align or recall),
    and I accepted. The design question is ANSWERED. Whether the bead closes or stays open for the
    materialiser slice is yours - the slice itself is blocked behind bd-01M19956, since carrying
    supportWeight into the trace today would publish "fully supported" on every external row.

STILL GENUINELY OPEN AND MINE:

  bd-01M1606BEK9P4437GKVHFV1KPY   membership routing - awaiting your ruling since 17:0x. Work is
    intact in stash@{2} on branch m1/membership-routing, 60 insertions, nothing committed. The
    Scoring.scala reservation EXPIRED and I did not re-take it, so the path is free.

  bd-01M174W3D9AZG2FGSRM11FZ7ZQ   MassRatio.unsafe vs NaN. NOT verified either way. `unsafe` is
    private[align] and signature.scala:212 reads `if conditioning <= 0.0 then None else Some(...)`,
    which with conditioning = NaN takes the ELSE branch and yields Some(NaN). Whether that is
    reachable depends on whether every align caller validates upstream, and I have not audited the
    callers. Its title claims it was "closed as a side effect" of another fix - I CANNOT CONFIRM
    THAT and would rather say so than let the claim stand unchecked. P3, so I have not spent more
    on it.

That is my whole docket. Nothing else of mine is waiting on you except cand-7KHF208, which is
waiting on cand-1EE04B rather than on anything you or I can do.
